
``` {r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(stars)
library(tmap)

```

```{r}
getwd()
```

```{r}
ei_points <- st_read(here('weekly-discussions',"easter_island", "ei_points.gpkg")) |> 
  filter(type == "volcano")
ei_elev <- read_stars(here('weekly-discussions',"easter_island", "ei_elev.tif"))
ei_borders <- st_read(here('weekly-discussions',"easter_island", "ei_border.gpkg"))
ei_roads <- st_read(here('weekly-discussions',"easter_island", "ei_roads.gpkg")) 
```


```{r}
# Add Easter Island vector in default gray
tm_shape(ei_borders) +
  tm_borders() +
# Set general map layout options
  tm_layout(main.title = "Easter Island")
```

```{r}
tm_shape(ei_borders) + 
    tm_borders()+
    tm_title("Easter Island")

```

```{r}
tm_shape(ei_elev)+
    tm_raster(col.scale= tm_scale_continuous(values = "-rd_yl_gn"))+
tm_shape(ei_borders) + 
    tm_borders()+
    tm_title("Easter Island")+
tm_shape(ei_roads)+
    tm_lines()+
tm_shape(ei_points)+
    tm_symbols(shape=24, 
                size = 'elevation', 
                size.legend = tm_legend('Volcaoes (m asl)' ))
tmap_mode('view')
```

```{r}
ei_map <- tm_shape(ei_elev) +
  tm_graticules() +
  tm_raster(col.scale = tm_scale_continuous(values = "-rd_yl_gn"),
            col.legend = tm_legend("Elevation (m asl)")) +
  tm_shape(ei_borders) + 
    tm_borders() +
  tm_shape(ei_roads) +
    tm_lines() +
  tm_shape(ei_points) +
    tm_symbols(shape = 24, 
               size = "elevation", 
               size.legend = tm_legend("Volcanoes (m asl)")) +
  tm_compass(position = c("right", "top")) +
  tm_scalebar() +
  tm_title("Easter Island")

ei_map
```
